content: Ollama thinking is a separate field from response/content. think must be top-level; putting it in options is ignored and thinking models can return an empty response. format json plus think true can yield invalid JSON. Gemma 3 model cards advertise a 128K window and do not document Gemma 4 thinking. think false is ignored on non-thinking models such as gemma2. Google thinking docs cover Gemma 4, not Gemma 3.
